_about: Destinations the Google Flights collector (gfcollect.py) watches from every ALERT_ORIGINS city. First 25 chosen 2026-10-12: places Indian travellers commonly fly. The second block (US, Canada, Africa, China, more Europe, Australia/NZ) added 2026-11-14 at the user's request. City codes (LON, PAR, TYO, SEL, NYC, CHI, WAS, YTO, BJS, SHA, ROM, MIL) cover all of a city's airports; NYC, BJS and YTO were checked live on 2026-11-14. Edit freely.
